I reviewed the diff (login URL prompt rework: `[Enter] / [c] copy / [o] open`, raw-mode single-key TTY reader, injectable `loginURLInteractor`). Build, unit tests, and the login integration tests pass locally; `mise run lint` does not.

### **#1 Escape sequences trigger prompt actions**

`readLoginURLActionBytes` reads one byte at a time and matches `c`/`o` anywhere in the stream. In raw mode the right-arrow key sends `ESC [ C` → silently copies; F1–F4 and application-mode arrows send `ESC O P` / `ESC O C` → the `O` opens the browser and returns from the prompt. Confirmed by running `readLoginURLActionBytes(strings.NewReader("\x1bOP"))` → `loginURLOpen`.
